messages.text: I’ll read the new comments on PR #90, make the changes, and update the PR with validation results.

The comments ask for ACTS propagation through the chamber envelopes in the joint field map, recording boundary intersections and counting only the two large faces as segment proxies. I’ll check the local ACTS setup, then compare low, intermediate and 1 TeV muons with XY/RZ hit views and coverage maps.
I’m using the `acts-spack` skill and the repository’s design and review workflow to keep the ACTS run traceable. I’ll preserve the current chamber layout and magnetic map as fixed inputs.

The preflight found that the recorded setup and lockfile have changed, so it cannot certify the current environment yet. It also lacks staged DD4hep/Geant4 sources. I’ll verify the ACTS checkout and runtime directly; the requested envelope-only propagation should not need those two source trees.

The field map has masked winding regions, including the solenoid crossed by tracks from the interaction point. I’ll start the main scan at a closed muon-system entrance surface and label momentum there explicitly. The earlier 5 GeV central IP benchmark corresponds to about 2.65 GeV after the calorimeters; I’ll include that local stress case, 5, 10, 100 and 1,000 GeV, both charges, and retain field failures in the denominators.

The installed ACTS package configuration fails on an unused plugin dependency: it requests vecmem 1.27, while the current environment has 1.28. I’ll try linking the installed ACTS Core target directly, with its Eigen and Boost dependencies. That avoids changing the shared installation.
The ACTS Core adapter now compiles. I’m checking its field interpolation and chamber crossings, including a curved track near a chamber edge, before running the coverage scan.
